ch2-001.does: Loads the résumé experiment CSV into a data frame named resume (one row per fictitious résumé).

ch2-002.does: Returns the dimensions of the data frame.
ch2-002.out: The number of résumés (rows) and number of variables (columns).

ch2-003.does: Shows the first six rows of the data frame.
ch2-003.out: The first six résumés: first name, sex, race, and whether each got a callback.

ch2-004.does: Summarizes every variable: counts per level for factors, quantiles and mean for numeric variables.
ch2-004.out: Counts of résumés by first name, sex, and race, plus the distribution of call; the mean of call is the overall callback rate.

ch2-005.does: Builds a two-way contingency table of race (rows) by callback (columns) and stores it.

ch2-006.out: Counts of résumés in each race-by-callback cell (rows: black, white; columns: 0 = no callback, 1 = callback).

ch2-007.does: Adds row and column totals (margins) to the table.
ch2-007.out: The race-by-callback counts plus row totals, column totals, and the grand total (sample size).

ch2-008.does: Sums the second column (callbacks) and divides by the number of rows.
ch2-008.out: The overall callback rate across all résumés.

ch2-009.does: Divides the black/callback cell by the total of the black row.
ch2-009.out: The callback rate for résumés with black-sounding names.

ch2-010.does: Divides the white/callback cell by the total of the white row.
ch2-010.out: The callback rate for résumés with white-sounding names.

ch2-011.does: Extracts the first row of the table (blank column index = all columns).
ch2-011.out: Counts of no-callback and callback among black-sounding names.

ch2-012.does: Extracts the second column of the table (blank row index = all rows).
ch2-012.out: Number of callbacks for each race.

ch2-013.does: Takes the mean of a 0/1 variable, which equals the proportion of 1s.
ch2-013.out: The overall callback rate (proportion of résumés with a callback).

ch2-014.does: Asks for the class of the value TRUE.

ch2-018.does: Takes the mean of a logical vector; TRUE counts as 1 and FALSE as 0.

ch2-020.does: Logical AND: TRUE only if both sides are TRUE.
ch2-020.out: The result of FALSE AND TRUE.

ch2-021.does: Logical AND of two TRUE values.
ch2-021.out: The result of TRUE AND TRUE.

ch2-022.does: Logical OR: TRUE if at least one side is TRUE.
ch2-022.out: The result of TRUE OR FALSE.

ch2-023.does: Logical OR of two FALSE values.
ch2-023.out: The result of FALSE OR FALSE.

ch2-024.does: Chains AND across three values; all must be TRUE.
ch2-024.out: The result of TRUE AND FALSE AND TRUE.

ch2-025.does: Evaluates the OR inside parentheses first, then ANDs with FALSE.
ch2-025.out: The result of (TRUE OR FALSE) AND FALSE.

ch2-026.does: Evaluates the AND inside parentheses first, then ORs with TRUE.
ch2-026.out: The result of TRUE OR (FALSE AND FALSE).

ch2-027.does: Creates the first of two logical vectors.

ch2-029.does: Elementwise OR comparing the two vectors position by position.
ch2-029.out: For each position, whether at least one of TF1 or TF2 is TRUE.

ch2-030.does: Elementwise AND comparing the two vectors position by position.
ch2-030.out: For each position, whether both TF1 and TF2 are TRUE.

ch2-032.does: Tests string equality; R is case-sensitive.
ch2-032.out: Whether "Hello" equals "hello" (it does not, because of case).

ch2-035.out: For each element of x, whether it is at least 2.

ch2-036.does: Tests every element for inequality with 1.
ch2-036.out: For each element of x, whether it differs from 1.

ch2-037.does: Combines two elementwise comparisons with AND.
ch2-037.out: For each element, whether it is greater than 0 AND at most 2.

ch2-038.does: Combines two elementwise comparisons with OR.
ch2-038.out: For each element, whether it is greater than 2 OR at most -1.

ch2-039.does: Stores the result of a combined condition as a logical vector.

ch2-040.out: For each element of x, whether it is in the interval (0, 2].

ch2-041.out: The proportion of elements of x in (0, 2].

ch2-042.out: The number of elements of x in (0, 2].

ch2-043.does: Subsets call to résumés whose race equals "black" using a logical index, then takes the mean.
ch2-043.out: The callback rate among résumés with black-sounding names.

ch2-044.does: Shows the race of the first five résumés; the Levels line lists the factor's categories.
ch2-044.out: Race of résumés 1 to 5, with the factor levels black and white.

ch2-045.does: Builds the logical vector race == "black" and shows its first five elements.
ch2-045.out: For résumés 1 to 5, whether each has a black-sounding name.

ch2-046.does: Returns the dimensions of the full data frame.
ch2-046.out: Rows and columns of the full résumé data.

ch2-047.does: Keeps only rows where race is black (logical row index, blank column index = all columns).

ch2-048.does: Returns the dimensions of the subset.
ch2-048.out: Rows and columns of the black-name subset (fewer rows, same columns).

ch2-049.does: Mean of call within the subset data frame.
ch2-049.out: The callback rate among résumés with black-sounding names.

ch2-050.does: Uses subset() to keep the call and firstname columns (select) for rows that are black AND female (subset).

ch2-051.does: Shows the first rows of the black-female subset; row names keep the original row numbers.
ch2-051.out: Callback and first name for the first few black-female résumés.

ch2-052.does: Subsets résumés that are black AND male (all columns kept).

ch2-053.does: Subsets résumés that are white AND female.

ch2-054.does: Subsets résumés that are white AND male.

ch2-055.does: Difference in callback rates: white females minus black females.
ch2-055.out: The racial gap in callback rates among female applicants.

ch2-056.does: Difference in callback rates: white males minus black males.
ch2-056.out: The racial gap in callback rates among male applicants.

ch2-057.does: Uses ifelse() to create a 0/1 indicator equal to 1 only when race is black AND sex is female.

ch2-058.does: Three-way table of race by sex, shown separately for BlackFemale = 0 and BlackFemale = 1.
ch2-058.out: Counts confirming the indicator equals 1 only for black females.

ch2-059.does: Creates a new variable type filled with missing values.

ch2-060.does: Assigns the label BlackFemale to rows meeting both conditions (indexing on the left of <-).

ch2-061.does: Assigns the label BlackMale to rows meeting both conditions.

ch2-062.does: Assigns the label WhiteFemale to rows meeting both conditions.

ch2-063.does: Assigns the label WhiteMale to rows meeting both conditions.

ch2-064.does: Checks the class of the new variable.
ch2-064.out: The class: character (it holds text labels, not yet a factor).

ch2-065.does: Converts the character variable into a factor with as.factor().

ch2-066.does: Lists the factor's levels (alphabetical by default).
ch2-066.out: The four categories of type, in alphabetical order.

ch2-067.does: Counts observations in each level of the factor.
ch2-067.out: Number of résumés in each race-by-sex category.

ch2-068.does: tapply() applies mean() to call separately within each level of type.
ch2-068.out: The callback rate for each race-by-sex category.

ch2-069.does: Converts first name into a factor.

ch2-070.does: Computes the callback rate for each first name with tapply() and stores it.

ch2-071.does: Sorts the name-level callback rates from lowest to highest.
ch2-071.out: Callback rate for each first name, ordered from lowest to highest.

ch2-072.does: Extracts the first row (all columns) of the data frame.
ch2-072.out: Every variable for résumé 1: one unit, for which only one potential outcome is observed.

ch2-073.does: Loads the social pressure experiment data (one row per registered voter).

ch2-074.does: Summarizes every variable in the data set.
ch2-074.out: Counts by sex and message group, and the distributions of birth year, past turnout, 2006 turnout, and household size.

ch2-075.does: tapply() computes mean 2006 turnout within each message group.
ch2-075.out: The turnout rate in each experimental group.

ch2-076.does: Mean of 2006 turnout among voters in the Control group (logical subsetting).
ch2-076.out: The turnout rate in the Control group.

ch2-077.does: Subtracts the Control turnout rate from every group's turnout rate.
ch2-077.out: Each message's estimated average effect on turnout relative to Control (Control's entry is 0).

ch2-078.does: Creates an age variable from year of birth (a pretreatment covariate).

ch2-079.does: Mean age within each message group.
ch2-079.out: Average age by group: a balance check on a pretreatment variable.

ch2-080.does: Mean 2004 primary turnout within each message group.
ch2-080.out: Past turnout rate by group: a balance check on a pretreatment variable.

ch2-081.does: Mean household size within each message group.
ch2-081.out: Average household size by group: a balance check on a pretreatment variable.

ch2-082.does: Loads the minimum-wage data (one row per fast-food restaurant).

ch2-083.does: Returns the dimensions of the data.
ch2-083.out: Number of restaurants and number of variables.

ch2-084.out: Counts by chain and location, and quantiles/means of wages and full- and part-time employee counts before and after.

ch2-085.does: Keeps restaurants whose location is not PA (the treated state, New Jersey).

ch2-086.does: Keeps restaurants located in PA (the control state).

ch2-087.does: Mean of a logical comparison: share of NJ restaurants paying under $5.05 before the law.
ch2-087.out: Proportion of NJ restaurants below the new minimum wage before the increase.

ch2-088.does: Share of NJ restaurants paying under $5.05 after the law.
ch2-088.out: Proportion of NJ restaurants below the new minimum wage after the increase.

ch2-089.does: Share of PA restaurants paying under $5.05 before.
ch2-089.out: Proportion of PA restaurants below $5.05 before the NJ increase.

ch2-090.does: Share of PA restaurants paying under $5.05 after.
ch2-090.out: Proportion of PA restaurants below $5.05 after the NJ increase.

ch2-091.does: Creates the post-treatment proportion of full-time employees for each NJ restaurant: full / (full + part).

ch2-092.does: Creates the same post-treatment full-time proportion for each PA restaurant.

ch2-093.does: Cross-section difference in means: NJ minus PA, after the increase.
ch2-093.out: The cross-section estimate of the minimum wage's effect on the full-time employment share.

ch2-094.does: prop.table() converts a table of chain counts into proportions, for NJ.
ch2-094.out: Share of NJ restaurants belonging to each chain.

ch2-095.out: Share of PA restaurants belonging to each chain.

ch2-096.does: Subclassification: keeps only Burger King restaurants in NJ.

ch2-097.does: Keeps only Burger King restaurants in PA.

ch2-098.does: Difference in means within the Burger King subclass.
ch2-098.out: The NJ-minus-PA difference in full-time share among Burger Kings only (controlling for chain).

ch2-099.does: Further subclassifies: NJ Burger Kings outside shore and central NJ (closer to PA).

ch2-100.does: Difference in means within the chain-and-location subclass.
ch2-100.out: The NJ-minus-PA difference in full-time share among Burger Kings in NJ regions near PA.

ch2-101.does: Creates the pre-treatment full-time proportion for NJ restaurants.

ch2-102.does: Before-and-after difference in NJ: mean after minus mean before, stored as NJdiff.

ch2-103.out: The before-and-after estimate: change in NJ's mean full-time share.

ch2-104.does: Creates the pre-treatment full-time proportion for PA restaurants.

ch2-105.does: Before-and-after difference in PA (the control group's time trend), stored as PAdiff.

ch2-106.does: Difference-in-differences: NJ's change minus PA's change.
ch2-106.out: The difference-in-differences estimate of the effect on the full-time share (an SATT estimate).

ch2-107.does: Recreates the PA pre-treatment full-time proportion (the book's code repeats this block).

ch2-110.does: Cross-section comparison using medians instead of means.
ch2-110.out: The NJ-minus-PA difference in median full-time share after the increase.

ch2-111.does: Before-and-after difference in NJ using medians, stored as NJdiff.med.

ch2-112.out: The change in NJ's median full-time share.

ch2-113.does: Before-and-after difference in PA using medians.

ch2-115.does: summary() of a numeric variable: min, quartiles, median, mean, max.
ch2-115.out: Distribution of NJ wages before the increase.

ch2-116.out: Distribution of NJ wages after the increase (bunched at the new minimum).

ch2-117.does: Interquartile range: upper quartile minus lower quartile.
ch2-117.out: The spread of the middle 50% of NJ wages before.

ch2-118.does: Interquartile range of NJ wages after.
ch2-118.out: The spread of the middle 50% of NJ wages after (zero: both quartiles equal the new minimum).

ch2-119.out: Deciles of NJ wages before the increase.

ch2-120.does: Deciles of NJ wages after the increase.
ch2-120.out: Deciles of NJ wages after the increase.

ch2-121.does: Root mean square of the change: square, take the mean, take the square root.
ch2-121.out: The average magnitude of the change in full-time share, ignoring sign (RMS).

ch2-122.does: Mean of the change in full-time share.
ch2-122.out: The average signed change in full-time share (close to zero, unlike the RMS).

ch2-123.does: Standard deviation (uses n - 1 in the denominator).
ch2-123.out: SD of the full-time share before the increase.

ch2-124.out: SD of the full-time share after the increase.

ch2-125.does: Variance: the square of the standard deviation.
ch2-125.out: Variance of the full-time share before the increase.

ch2-126.out: Variance of the full-time share after the increase.
